# Copilot Instructions for WeChat webGIS project

This document provides instructions for GitHub Copilot when working with this repository.

## Project Overview

This is a WeChat webGIS project that combines WeChat Mini Program development with Geographic Information System (GIS) web capabilities.

## Coding Guidelines

- Follow consistent code formatting and naming conventions
- Write clear, self-documenting code with appropriate comments
- Ensure all code is properly tested before committing
- Use meaningful commit messages

## Technology Stack

When contributing to this project, be aware of the following technologies that may be used:

- WeChat Mini Program framework
- Web-based GIS libraries and APIs
- JavaScript/TypeScript for frontend development

## Best Practices

- Keep components modular and reusable
- Follow security best practices, especially when handling user data
- Optimize for performance on mobile devices
- Ensure accessibility and cross-platform compatibility
